execution: Unity, 2026-11-08; our panel solves and original pretrained LWM inference. No new CFD, retraining or measured-lift conditioning.

reference.correction: Raw supplied holdout measurements, no added corrections.
reference.reportedCLSource: LWM paper unconditioned validation discussion; never used to fit this prediction.

lwm.conditioning: None: no measured lift supplied to posterior.
lwm.covarianceConvention: Original upstream average of checkpoint covariances plus original 1e-4 output diagonal floor. Does not include between-checkpoint mean variance or model-form error.

panels.notes: Own incompressible panel solve. Analytic closed-TE NACA and rounded tip; source LWM uses sampled section geometry and implicit tip. Dimensional flow is illustrative; compare coefficients.

scope.method: Surface panels on the finite-thickness wing (experimental candidate): doublets a C1 quadratic spline in both surface directions, quadratic on each triangle of every panel and continuous over the whole body (tensor-quadratic; the span-quadratic model, also used with the diagnostic flat tip cap, and the constant 0.3.1 model remain selectable); sources constant on each triangle; internal Dirichlet condition; Morino Kutta condition matched pointwise along the trailing edge; flat semi-infinite wake along body +x carrying the jump of the trailing-edge doublet traces; surface velocity from the jump relations of the solved sheet, quadratic Cp integrated exactly; symmetric image half-wing.
scope.flow: Steady, incompressible, inviscid, attached. Mach <= 0.3 enforced; no compressibility correction.
excluded: boundary layer, transition and viscous (profile) drag
leading-edge vortex lift of slender or delta wings
sideslip, roll/yaw rates and asymmetric flight
blunt trailing-edge base flow (trailing edge is closed sharp for aerodynamics)
scope.claim: Numerical potential-flow estimate; accuracy is demonstrated only by the listed benchmark tests, not certified.

warnings: Local geometric angle reaches 8.8 deg. This attached-flow model does not predict stall; treat results beyond the linear range as unsupported.

diagnostics.trefftzDragMethod: span-quadratic wake strength (solver basis), 16 sub-segments per strip
